summary: Reads messages from a POP3 mailbox on a schedule.

properties.name: Encryption
properties.description: implicit for POP3 over TLS from the first byte (usually port 995), or explicit for POP3 that upgrades the connection with STLS (usually port 110). The password is never sent unencrypted.

properties.name: Port
properties.description: The server's port. 995 with implicit TLS, 110 with explicit, when empty.

properties.name: CertificateThumbprint
properties.description: The SHA-256 thumbprint of the server's certificate, in hex. When set, exactly that certificate is trusted, a self-signed one included, and any other is refused before credentials are sent. When empty, the certificate must be valid.

properties.name: BatchSize
properties.description: Maximum number of messages to fetch per polling batch.

properties.name: ResponseEncoding
properties.description: Encoding used to decode message contents (e.g. utf8).
